tests.description: Gateway rejects wrong JWS typ, issuer, key, caller, audience, Tenant, Principal, execution scope, ProviderRevision, target, purpose, Secret reference, Contract, Digest Profile or request digest.
SecretGrant and token are single-use; replay, expiration and revocation fail closed before material release.
Grant consumption and immutable audit identity commit before delivery; unavailable audit persistence denies access.
Secret material and delivery handles are absent from Platform databases, Redis, Temporal History, queues, logs, traces, Events, Artifact, snapshots and RuntimeRecording.
Token and delivery never outlive 300 seconds, SecretGrant, operation deadline, CommercialAuthorization or PolicyDecision.
